title: Receipts
summary: Keep a receipt on each Ledger line. Send one in on its own and it finds its line by amount and day, or asks which one. Mark the categories you keep receipts for, such as work costs or anything with a warranty, and see which lines from this month and last still want one.
changes: Brings its Receipts widget for Today, which was BrainDog’s own until now.
author: BrainDog

widgets.title: Receipts
widgets.says: Payments still missing a receipt, and receipts waiting to be matched.

declarations.name: Receipts
declarations.holds: a receipt sent in on its own, with the shop, the day and the amount, until it is put on its line in the Ledger
